introHtml: Custom adjustable lab coats give your team a professional, tailored look without the need for individual measurements. Features like adjustable cuffs, snap closures, and drawstring waists ensure a comfortable fit for a range of body types. Ideal for labs, medical offices, or university science departments, these coats can be embroidered with your logo or department name. Durable cotton-poly blends resist stains and frequent washing, making them a practical choice for daily use.
